row.body: seed/worker/src/codeagent.js parses EDIT and FILE blocks and applyEdit places them exactly or by indentation-loose match; seed/worker/src/pr-executor.js shows the named files and resolves edits against the branch file. seed/worker/test/patch-edit.test.js passes 4 tests.
